payloads.name: PS5 LocalSend
payloads.description: Native LocalSend protocol payload for PlayStation 5 with a browser dashboard
payloads.author: heydemoura
payloads.release_notes:
Initial public release of PS5 LocalSend.

## Features

- Native LocalSend protocol implementation for PS5
- Browser-based dashboard for file management
- Send and receive files wirelessly between devices
- Persistent receive folder selection

Load the payload on your PS5 via an ELF loader (port 9021):

```sh
nc -q0 <ps5-ip> 9021 < ps5-localsend.elf
```

Then open the dashboard URL shown on screen. Use any LocalSend-compatible app to send and receive files.

payloads.name: SyncPS5
payloads.description: Syncthing running on a jailbroken PS5 as an ELF payload service
payloads.author: heydemoura
payloads.release_notes:
Send the payload to an ELF loader on the PS5 (port 9021), e.g.:

```sh
nc -q0 <ps5-ip> 9021 < syncps5-v0.2.0.elf
```

Then open `http://<ps5-ip>:8384` and set a GUI password first. See the README for installing it at `/data/syncps5/syncps5.elf` (needed for restart from the GUI and for autoloaders).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/heydemoura/syncps5/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

payloads.name: PS5 HowLongToBeat
payloads.description: Native home-screen completion estimates for PS5 games with a persistent 30-day cache
payloads.author: heydemoura
payloads.release_notes:
## Native completion metrics and game-switch stability

Download **hltb.elf** and send it to elfldr. The single payload installs and enables the metrics panel. **hltb-query.elf** is an optional stdout query diagnostic. **SHA256SUMS** covers both files.

- Show Main Story, Main + Extra, and Completionist estimates in one native panel for every matched game, including games without played time.
- Keep the panel visible with Play Game unfocused, using fixed screen placement and consistent native typography, padding, translucent background, and rounded corners. Preserve the original title and played-time controls.
- Fix the repeated game-switch crash by hosting the panel outside React's managed widget tree. Keep one active panel, coalesce navigation events, release old selection handles on the UI thread, and run at most one background lookup at a time.
- Cache all three estimates for 30 days in `/user/hltb/cache.json`. Valid saved results display without another network request and survive reboot. Migrate the previous temporary cache automatically.
- Build and publish release payloads automatically with GitHub Actions. Pull requests run the same build and sanitizer tests.

Validation includes host ASan/UBSan tests for 2,000 game switches, 100,000 coalesced updates, construction failures, and 1,000 network lookups with resource accounting. Console checks on firmware 12.20 confirmed repeated switching and visibility without Play Game focus; the README includes a native ASTRO BOT screenshot.

Only firmware **12.20** has been tested. Estimates depend on HowLongToBeat's unofficial website API and title matching; missing extra/completionist estimates display `N/A`. Restart ShellUI or reboot before loading this version over an older resident payload.

payloads.name: PS5 Perf
payloads.description: perf-style sampling profiler: stat, record, report, top and flame graphs for PS5 processes over TCP
payloads.author: heydemoura
payloads.release_notes:
First release of ps5-perf, a perf-style sampling profiler payload for the PS5.

**Assets**
- `ps5-perf.elf`: the payload. Send it to elfldr, e.g. `nc -q0 <ps5> 9021 < ps5-perf.elf`. It listens on TCP port 9077.
- `ps5perf.py`: the host client (Python 3). It records, symbolizes Sony NIDs and writes perf-script text, folded stacks, an SVG flame graph and reports.

Built with ps5-payload-dev SDK v0.45 and tested on firmware 12.20. Kernel struct thread offsets are calibrated at runtime. See the README for commands, sampling modes and limitations.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

payloads.name: PS5 Memcard
payloads.description: Keeps every PS5 and PS4 save mirrored on USB memory cards under /memcard and imports them into any profile from a web page
payloads.author: heydemoura
payloads.release_notes:
ps5-memcard keeps every save on the console (PS5 and PS4 titles, all profiles) copied to USB drives under `/memcard`, and brings any of them back into any profile from a web page.

## Use

1. Plug a USB drive (exFAT or FAT32) into the PS5.
2. Send `ps5-memcard.elf` to the ELF loader on port 9021:

   ```sh
   nc -q0 <ps5-ip> 9021 < ps5-memcard.elf
   ```

3. Open `http://<ps5-ip>:8083/`, or use the **PS5 Memcard** shortcut the payload adds to the Media tab.

## In this version

- The home screen and notification icon no longer has a label written on the card.

Tested on firmware 12.20 with one USB drive. Not yet tried on a console: a real game's save (the tests used a synthetic PS5 save), PS4 saves, and two drives at once. Save handling is built on [Garlic SaveMgr](https://github.com/earthonion/garlic-savemgr) by earthonion.
